title: Matrix Stiffness Induces Endothelial Network Senescence
comparison_or_design: Soft versus Stiff hydrogel conditions after the initial network-formation period.
time_scope: 48 hours of initial network formation followed by 48 hours in the assigned stiffness condition (day 4).
excluded: Intermediate-stiffness conditions, Notch/JNK drug interventions and implant-capsule cohorts
Western blot, immunofluorescence, dsDNA, SA-β-gal, sequencing and other assays
population_or_material: Human endothelial-network preparations used for the day-4 senescence-marker qRT-PCR comparison.
requested_items: Soft versus dynamically stiffened hydrogel, stiffness-switch schedule and qRT-PCR collection interval
